title: Pure Maju
summary: The Maju strategy is an explosive banish-beatdown OTK deck centered around Gren Maju Da Eiza (which gains 400 ATK and DEF for every one of your banished cards) alongside Great Maju Garzett and Legendary Maju Garzett. By banishing 10 cards from the top of your Deck with Pot of Desires, 8 cards with Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slasher, and 6+ cards from your Extra Deck with Eater of Millions, a single Normal Summoned Level 3 Gren Maju Da Eiza immediately hits the board with 8,000 to 12,000+ ATK—and tributing it for Great Maju Garzett doubles that ATK for a massive blow!

allow.Pot of Desires: Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards—immediately giving Gren Maju Da Eiza +4000 ATK and DEF!
allow.Pot of Extravagance: Banishes 6 random face-down cards from your Extra Deck at the start of Main Phase 1 to draw 2 cards and give Gren Maju Da Eiza +2400 ATK.
allow.Macro Cosmos: Continuous Trap that banishes every card sent to the GY, fueling Gren Maju Da Eiza while shutting down the opponent's graveyard.
allow.Dimensional Fissure: Continuous Spell that banishes any monster sent to the GY, continuously boosting Gren Maju Da Eiza.
allow.Necroface: Level 4 Zombie that shuffles all banished cards back into the Deck on Normal Summon, OR banishes the top 5 cards of BOTH Decks whenever it is banished!
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK monster (like Necroface, triggering 10 more banished cards, or Gizmek Orochi!).
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Gizmek Orochi and Legendary Maju Garzett.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Gizmek Orochi and Legendary Maju Garzett for non-targeting removal.
allow.Relinquished Anima: Link-1 summoned using Level 1 Eater of Millions to absorb an opponent's monster.

main: Gren Maju Da Eiza

Signature Level 3 FIRE Fiend (? ATK / ? DEF): its ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of your banished cards x 400—reaching 4000 ATK off a single Pot of Desires and 8000+ ATK alongside Gizmek Orochi!
Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slasher
Level 8 DARK Machine (2450 ATK): Quick Effect while in your hand or GY to banish the top 8 cards of your Deck face-down and Special Summon itself—instantly adding +3200 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza!
Great Maju Garzett
Level 6 DARK Fiend: its ATK becomes equal to TWICE the original ATK of the 1 monster you Tributed for its Tribute Summon.
Legendary Maju Garzett
Level 8 DARK Fiend: Special Summons itself from your hand by Tributing all monsters you control, gains their combined original ATK, and inflicts piercing battle damage!
Maju Garzett
Original Level 7 DARK Fiend that gains the combined ATK of the 2 monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon.
Eater of Millions

Level 1 DARK Fiend: banishes 5 or more cards from your hand, field, and/or Extra Deck face-down to Special Summon itself, adding +2000 to +6000 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza while banishing any monster it battles face-down.
Necroface
When banished, banishes the top 5 cards of BOTH players' Decks (+2000 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza!).
Pot of Desires
Banishes 10 cards from your Deck face-down (+4000 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza) to draw 2 cards.
Pot of Extravagance
Banishes 6 Extra Deck cards face-down (+2400 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza) to draw 2 cards.
Allure of Darkness
Draws 2 cards and banishes Necroface or a DARK Maju Garzett from your hand.
Dimensional Fissure
Banishes all monsters sent to the GY, fueling Gren Maju Da Eiza while disrupting the opponent.
Macro Cosmos
Banishes all cards sent to the GY, continuously increasing Gren Maju Da Eiza's ATK.
